panelBody: Share a link or screenshots for the team to review. Only approved submissions appear in the community channels.
screenshotsHint: Up to 4 PNG, JPEG or WebP images; 8 MB each, 20 MB total. Updates replace all images.
creditHint: Leave empty to publish anonymously. Moderators can still see who submitted it.
received: Your submission is waiting for moderator review. You can check it using My submissions.
empty: You have no submissions on this page.
reviseHint: Upload all screenshots again, including any you want to keep. Your update will need a new review.
notification: There is an update to your submission in {server}. Use /submissions mine in that server to view it.
panelPosted: The submission panel is ready in {channel}.
guildOnly: Use this feature inside a server.
unavailable: Submissions are unavailable here or you do not have permission to use this category.
setup: The configured channels or roles need attention. Ask an administrator to check Submissions in the dashboard and the channel permissions.
stale: This submission has changed. Refresh its status before trying again.
missing: This submission or control is no longer available to you.
invalid: Add an explanation and at least one valid HTTP/HTTPS link or screenshot. Credit names can contain up to 100 characters.
imagesInvalid: Use up to 4 PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshots, at most 8 MB each and 20 MB in total. The images could not be read; please upload them again.
cooldown: Please wait a minute between submissions or updates.
capacity: You already have 5 active submissions. Wait for a review before submitting another.
uploadFailed: Your submission could not be sent for review. Open My submissions to try updating it again.
publishFailed: Publishing failed before a post was confirmed. The submission remains available for review; check the destination permissions before approving again.
uncertain: Discord may have received the post, but delivery could not be confirmed. Use Find published post to reconcile it; it will not be sent again automatically.
notLocated: No matching post was found in the latest 100 destination messages. Check the channel manually; this submission remains uncertain to prevent a duplicate.
failure: The action could not be completed. Check the submission status before trying again.
